title: Temel Gramer Karma Atölye: Past, Will, Should & Can
description: 20 cümlelik pratik: Geçmiş Zaman (Past), Gelecek Zaman (Will), Tavsiye (Should) ve Yetenek (Can) yapıları.

items.target_hint: Past Simple | drink -> drank veya have -> had coffee
Past Simple | clean -> cleaned my room, last Sunday

items.turkish_sentence: Geçen ay yeni bir bilgisayar satın aldım.
items.target_hint: Past Simple | buy -> bought a new computer, last month

items.turkish_sentence: Dün gece televizyon izlemedim, erken uyudum.
items.target_hint: Past Simple (Olumsuz & Olumlu) | didn't watch TV, slept early / went to bed early

items.turkish_sentence: Geçen hafta sonu müzeyi ziyaret ettik.
items.target_hint: Past Simple | visit -> visited the museum, last weekend
Future (Will) | will send you an email, tomorrow morning
Future (Will) | will travel / will go to Istanbul, next week
Future (Will) | will help you, don't worry
Future (Will) | the meeting will start / begin at two o'clock
Future (Will) | will eat out / will have dinner outside this evening

items.turkish_sentence: Her gün daha fazla su içmelisin.
items.target_hint: Tavsiye (Should) | you should drink more water every day

items.turkish_sentence: İngilizce öğrenmek için düzenli pratik yapmalısın.
items.target_hint: Tavsiye (Should) | should practice regularly to learn English
Tavsiye (Should) | you look very tired, you should rest / take some rest

items.turkish_sentence: Bu kadar geç saatte kahve içmemelisin.
items.target_hint: Tavsiye (Should not) | you shouldn't drink coffee this late
Tavsiye (Should) | I think you should see a doctor / visit a doctor
Yetenek (Can) | I can swim very well
Rica (Can) | Can you pass me the salt, please?
İmkân (Can) | We can speak English comfortably here
Yetenek (Can) | I can solve this problem easily
İmkân (Can) | I can come to the cinema with you tomorrow

title: A1/A2 - Günlük Hayat & Geçmiş Zaman
description: Geçmiş zaman (Simple Past) kalıplarını pekiştirme atölyesi

items.target_hint: play -> played, with my friends, yesterday evening

items.turkish_sentence: Sabah saat yedide uyandım ve kahvaltı yaptım.
items.target_hint: wake up -> woke up, have breakfast -> had breakfast

items.turkish_sentence: Geçen hafta yeni bir İngilizce kitabı satın aldım.
